parameters.content:
# Website updates to Instagram videos · V3

### How it works
For small editorial teams turning a public article, product page or release note into Instagram content.

1. A manual or daily run reads selected facts and skips revisions already handled.
2. OpenAI writes the copy; a separate review allows one correction.
3. Creatomate renders one video or a four-video carousel.
4. Email approval gates optional Instagram publication; a Data Table keeps progress and receipts.

### Setup
- [ ] In **Configure V3 only**, choose a dedicated `jobsTable`. Run `action: setup` once, sequentially.
- [ ] Connect OpenAI, Creatomate Header Auth and SMTP credentials. For publishing, connect Meta OAuth with Instagram publishing permissions.
- [ ] Set `sourceUrl`, CSS selectors, brand, email addresses and current model prices. Use a professional Instagram account and public HTTPS approval links.
- [ ] Run `action: preview` with `generationEnabled: true`; keep `publishingEnabled: false`. Inspect all videos and test approval/rejection.
- [ ] To publish, configure the exact Instagram destination and use `action: publish` with `publishingEnabled: true`. Test before enabling the disabled schedule.

### Customization
Choose `single` or `carousel`, English or Italian, CTA and optional licensed image/music URLs.

Preview uses paid APIs and sends email. Uncertain requests need manual reconciliation. Remote services still require live acceptance testing.

[Complete setup and recovery guide](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/social/social-posts-carousels/V3/documentation.md)

## 1. Detect a new source revision
Selected facts identify the revision; a Data Table records progress and prevents duplicate jobs. An atomic reservation serializes processing, including approval waits.

## Create the editorial register
Run `action: setup` once with a dedicated table name. Setup preserves existing records and makes no AI, rendering, email or social requests.

## 2. Write and review the copy
OpenAI drafts from selected facts, then checks accuracy and grammar. One correction is allowed before rejection; inspect the source claims yourself.

## 3. Render with Creatomate
Create one 16.5-second video or four ordered 5.5-second videos at 1080 × 1350. Saved render IDs let the workflow poll existing requests.

## 4. Review the exact video package
Email presents the videos, caption and destination for one decision. Rejection, expiry or changed content prevents publication; preview also sends this email.

## 5. Publish and keep the receipt
Publish only approved media to the verified Instagram account, then save its ID and permalink. Reconcile uncertain requests before retrying to avoid duplicates.
